en.s: The Battle of Arausio took place on 6 October 105 BC, at a site between the town of Arausio, now Orange, Vaucluse, and the Rhône river, when two Roman armies, commanded by proconsul Quintus Servilius Caepio and consul Gnaeus Mallius Maximus, suffered a major defeat at the hands of the Cimbri and Teuton migratory tribes who were led by Boiorix and Teutobod respectively.

zh.s: 公元前105年10月6日，奥劳西奥战役在今法国沃克吕兹省奥朗日镇与罗讷河之间爆发。昆图斯·塞尔维利乌斯·卡皮奥前执政官和格奈乌斯·马略执政官率领的两支罗马军队遭到辛布里人和条顿人部族联军惨败；联军分别由博伊奥里克斯和特乌托博德率领。

en.s: The Battle of Tigranocerta (Armenian: Տիգրանակերտի ճակատամարտ, Tigranakerti tchakatamart) was fought on 6 October 69 BC between the forces of the Roman Republic and the army of the Kingdom of Armenia led by King Tigranes the Great. The Roman force, led by Consul Lucius Licinius Lucullus, defeated Tigranes, and as a result, captured Tigranes' capital city of Tigranocerta.

zh.s: 公元前69年10月6日，罗马共和国军队与亚美尼亚王国国王提格兰大帝率领的军队在提格拉诺塞尔塔交战。卢基乌斯·李锡尼·卢库鲁斯执政官率领的罗马军队击败提格兰，并因此攻占了他的首都提格拉诺塞尔塔。

en.s: The Battle of Yanshi (Chinese: 偃師之戰) was fought on 5–6 October 618 between the armies of Wang Shichong and Li Mi, rival contenders for the succession of the Sui dynasty. Wang, who was still ostensibly a Sui loyalist and had been blockaded in Luoyang for months by Li, gambled on a decisive battle and led his troops out to attack the besieging army.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 偃师之战（中文：偃師之戰）于618年10月5日至6日爆发，交战双方为王世充和李密的军队，两人都是隋朝继承权的竞争者。李密将王世充围困在洛阳数月后，表面上仍忠于隋朝的王世充孤注一掷，率军出城，试图通过决战打破包围。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The siege of Aleppo by Baldwin II of Jerusalem and his allies lasted from 6 October 1124 to 25 January 1125. It ended in a Crusader withdrawal following the arrival of a relief force led by Aqsunqur al-Bursuqi.

zh.s: 耶路撒冷国王鲍德温二世及其盟友于1124年10月6日至1125年1月25日围攻阿勒颇。阿克松库尔·布尔苏奇率领的援军抵达后，十字军撤围，围城战随之结束。

en.s: In the campaign and Battle of al-Fule (in Crusader terms La Fève, Latin Castrum Fabe), a Crusader force led by Guy of Lusignan skirmished with Saladin's Ayyubid army for more than a week in September and October 1183. The fighting ended on 6 October with Saladin being forced to withdraw.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1183年9月至10月，吕西尼昂的居伊率领十字军与萨拉丁的阿尤布王朝军队在阿尔富莱附近交战一个多星期。这场战役又称拉费夫（拉丁语：Castrum Fabe）战役。战斗于10月6日结束，萨拉丁被迫撤退。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The attack on Monastir was an attempt by the Maltese knights of Hospitallers to attack and sack the Tunisian city of Monastir; the attack, however, failed.

zh.s: 马耳他医院骑士团试图袭击并洗劫突尼斯城市莫纳斯提尔，但行动失败。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Cape St. Vincent was a naval engagement that took place on 16 June or 6 October 1606, during Eighty Years' War and Dutch–Portuguese War. A Spanish fleet under Admiral Luis Fajardo attacked the Dutch fleet led by Admiral Willem Haultain and Vice Admiral Regnier Klaazoon, which was blocking the Spanish-Portuguese coast to intercept the Spanish treasure fleet.

zh.s: 圣文森特角海战是一场海战，发生于1606年6月16日或10月6日，正值八十年战争和荷兰—葡萄牙战争期间。西班牙舰队由海军上将路易斯·法哈多率领，袭击了荷兰舰队。荷兰舰队由海军上将威廉·豪尔泰因和副海军上将雷尼尔·克拉松指挥，当时正封锁西葡海岸，拦截西班牙宝船队。

en.s: The Battle of Daugavgrīva took place on October 6, 1609, during the Polish–Swedish War (1600–1611). The Poles and Lithuanians under Jan Karol Chodkiewicz's command stood victorious.

zh.s: 1609年10月6日，波兰—瑞典战争（1600—1611年）期间，道加瓦格里瓦战役爆发。扬·卡罗尔·霍德凯维奇指挥的波兰和立陶宛军队取得胜利。

en.s: The 1648 free election in the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth began on 6 October 1648, and ended on November 17 of the same year. The new King of Poland and Grand Duke of Lithuania was John II Casimir, the younger brother of previous king, Władysław IV, who had died on May 20, 1648.

zh.s: 1648年10月6日，波兰立陶宛联邦开始举行自由选举，并于同年11月17日结束。波兰国王兼立陶宛大公选出扬二世·卡齐米日；他是前任国王瓦迪斯瓦夫四世的弟弟。瓦迪斯瓦夫四世于1648年5月20日去世。

en.t: Sobieski joins the fighting at Krasnobród
en.s: On the morning of October 6, 1672, Jan Sobieski’s forces joined Cossack troops fighting a Tatar force near Krasnobród, in what is now Poland.
en.n: Sobieski had set out on the night of October 5–6; this entry records the fighting the following morning.

zh.t: 索别斯基率军加入克拉斯诺布鲁德战斗
zh.s: 1672年10月6日清晨，扬·索别斯基率军赶到克拉斯诺布鲁德附近，与正在同鞑靼军队交战的哥萨克部队会合，加入战斗。该地位于今天的波兰。
zh.n: 索别斯基于10月5日至6日夜间出发，这里记录的是次日清晨的战斗。

en.s: The siege of Lwów took place on September 20-October 6, 1672 during the Polish-Ottoman War of 1672-1676. The siege ended in a strategic Polish victory as the Ottomans could not capture the city after a two-week siege.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1672年9月20日至10月6日，波兰—奥斯曼战争期间，奥斯曼军队围攻利沃夫。围城持续两周后，奥斯曼军队未能攻占该城，波兰方面取得战略胜利。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Surrender of Tribsees (Danish: Overgivelsen af Tribsees, Swedish: Överlämnandet av Tribsees), also known as the Capitulation of Tribsees (Danish: Kapitulationen af Tribsees, Swedish: Kapitulationen av Tribsees), was a surrender of Swedish forces to the Danish General Duncan in the town of Tribsees on 6 October 1675 during the Scanian War.

zh.s: 特里布塞斯投降又称特里布塞斯陷落，是1675年10月6日斯科讷战争期间，瑞典军队在特里布塞斯镇向丹麦将军邓肯投降。

en.t: Thirteen immigrant families arrive in Philadelphia before founding Germantown
en.s: On October 6, 1683, thirteen immigrant families arrived by ship in Philadelphia. They went on to establish Germantown several weeks later.
en.n: October 6 marks their arrival, rather than the later establishment of the settlement.

zh.t: 十三户移民家庭抵达费城
zh.s: 1683年10月6日，十三户移民家庭乘船抵达费城。几周后，他们建立了日耳曼敦定居点。
zh.n: 10月6日是他们抵达费城的日期，定居点是在之后建立的。

en.s: The Battle of Ustechko (Polish: Uścieczko, Turkish: Yuvaniça) (October 6, 1694) was fought during the Polish–Ottoman War (1683–1699), between the armies of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth on the one hand and of Khanate of Crimea and Ottoman Empire on the other. Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth forces under the command of Stanisław Jan Jabłonowski defeated the Tatars and Ottomans forces commanded by Şehbaz Giray.

zh.s: 1694年10月6日，波兰—奥斯曼战争（1683—1699年）期间，波兰立陶宛联邦军队与克里米亚汗国及奥斯曼帝国军队交战。斯坦尼斯瓦夫·扬·亚布沃诺夫斯基指挥的波兰立陶宛联邦军队击败了谢赫巴兹·格莱率领的鞑靼人和奥斯曼军队。

en.s: The Northeast Coast campaign (also known as the Six Terrible Days) (10 August – 6 October 1703) was the first major campaign by the French of Queen Anne's War in New England. Alexandre Leneuf de La Vallière de Beaubassin led 500 troops made up of French colonial forces and the Wabanaki Confederacy of Acadia (200 Mi'kmaq and others from Norridgewock).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1703年8月10日至10月6日，安妮女王战争期间，法国军队在新英格兰发动首次大规模战役，又称“可怕的六天”。亚历山大·勒内夫·德·拉瓦利埃尔·德·博巴桑率领约500名士兵，包括法国殖民地军队和阿卡迪亚瓦巴纳基联盟成员（其中有200名米克马克人及其他部族成员）。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The siege of Annapolis Royal (also known as the siege of Fort Anne) in 1744 involved two of four attempts by the French, along with their Acadian and native allies, to regain the capital of Nova Scotia/Acadia, Annapolis Royal, during King George's War. The siege is noted for Governor of Nova Scotia Paul Mascarene successfully defending the last British outpost in the colony and for the first arrival of New England Ranger John Gorham to Nova Scotia.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 1744年安纳波利斯罗亚尔围城战
zh.s: 1744年，乔治王战争期间，法国及其阿卡迪亚和原住民盟友曾四次试图夺回新斯科舍省（阿卡迪亚）首府安纳波利斯罗亚尔，其中两次围攻该城。新斯科舍省省长保罗·马斯卡雷涅成功守住英国在该殖民地的最后据点；新英格兰游骑兵约翰·戈勒姆也首次抵达新斯科舍省。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Manila was fought during the Seven Years' War, from 24 September 1762 to 6 October 1762, between the Kingdom of Great Britain and the Kingdom of Spain in and around Manila, the capital of the Philippines, a Spanish colony at that time. The British won, leading to an eighteen-month occupation of Manila.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 七年战争期间，英国和西班牙王国于1762年9月24日至10月6日在菲律宾首都马尼拉及周边地区交战；当时菲律宾是西班牙殖民地。英国获胜，随后占领马尼拉18个月。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Battle of Forts Clinton and Montgomery
en.s: The Battle of Forts Clinton and Montgomery was an American Revolutionary War battle fought in the highlands of the Hudson River valley, not far from West Point, on October 6, 1777. British forces under the command of General Sir Henry Clinton captured Fort Clinton and Fort Montgomery, and then dismantled the Hudson River Chain. The purpose of the attack was to create a diversion to draw American troops from the army of General Horatio Gates, whose army was opposing British General John Burgoyne's attempt to gain control of the Hudson.

zh.t: 克林顿堡与蒙哥马利堡战役
zh.s: 克林顿堡与蒙哥马利堡战役是美国独立战争中的一场战斗，1777年10月6日发生在哈德逊河谷高地，距西点军校不远。亨利·克林顿爵士将军率领的英军攻占克林顿堡和蒙哥马利堡，随后拆除了哈德逊河链。此次进攻旨在调走霍雷肖·盖茨将军的部队；盖茨的军队当时正阻止约翰·伯戈因将军率领的英军控制哈德逊河。

loc: 美国新泽西州波特共和国

en.s: The Battle of Chestnut Neck was fought on October 6, 1778 in southern New Jersey during the American Revolutionary War, at Chestnut Neck, a settlement on the Little Egg Harbor River (now known as the Mullica River) near the present-day city of Port Republic, New Jersey, which was used as a base by privateers. The British retrieved some supplies and destroyed others, as well as destroying some residences and other buildings. Learning that Count Kazimierz Pułaski was on the way, the British quickly left by ship the following day. They had an encounter with Pulaski's forces a week later and caused heavy losses.

zh.s: 1778年10月6日，美国独立战争期间，栗颈战役在新泽西州南部爆发，地点是小埃格港河畔的栗颈聚落（今穆利卡河，靠近现今的新泽西州波特共和国市），当地曾是私掠船基地。英军取走部分补给、摧毁其余物资，还毁坏了一些住宅和其他建筑。英军获悉卡齐米日·普瓦斯基伯爵正在赶来，次日便迅速乘船离开。一周后，他们与普瓦斯基的部队交战，并造成对方重大损失。

en.s: The Action of 6 October 1779 was a minor but famous and furious naval engagement that took part in the early stages of the war between Britain and France in the Anglo-French War between the British Royal Navy frigate HMS Quebec and the frigate Surveillante of the French Navy. The battle ended with a French victory when Quebec was destroyed by an explosion.

zh.s: 1779年10月6日，英法战争初期，英国皇家海军“魁北克号”护卫舰与法国海军“守望号”护卫舰在海上进行了一场小规模但著名且激烈的交战。法国获胜，“魁北克号”因爆炸而毁。

en.s: The 1795 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on October 6, 1795. The Federalist former councilor Gunning Bedford Sr. defeated the Democratic-Republican senator from New Castle County Archibald Alexander. The election was seen as a referendum on the Jay Treaty, which the Democratic-Republicans opposed. Alexander was listed as the "Anti-Treaty" candidate in the Aurora General Advertiser.

zh.s: 1795年10月6日，特拉华州举行州长选举。联邦党前议员甘宁·贝德福德击败民主共和党候选人、纽卡斯尔县参议员阿奇博尔德·亚历山大。此次选举被视为对《杰伊条约》的公投，民主共和党反对该条约。《奥罗拉通用广告报》将亚历山大列为“反条约”候选人。

en.s: The Battle of Castricum (October 6, 1799) saw a Franco-Dutch force defeat an Anglo-Russian force near Castricum, Netherlands. The battle was fought during the War of the Second Coalition against Revolutionary France between French and Dutch forces under the command of General Guillaume Brune and Herman Willem Daendels and British and Russian forces under the command of the Duke of York, Sir Ralph Abercromby and the Prince of Orange.

zh.s: 1799年10月6日，法国和荷兰联军在荷兰卡斯特里克姆附近击败英俄联军。此战是第二次反法同盟战争的一部分。法国和荷兰军队由纪尧姆·布吕纳将军和赫尔曼·威廉·丹德尔斯指挥，英俄军队由约克公爵、拉尔夫·阿伯克龙比爵士和奥兰治亲王指挥。

en.s: The 1801 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on October 6, 1801. The Democratic-Republican candidate David Hall defeated the Federalist prothonotary for Sussex County, Delaware, Nathaniel Mitchell.

zh.s: 1801年10月6日，特拉华州举行州长选举。民主共和党候选人大卫·霍尔击败联邦党候选人、特拉华州苏塞克斯县首席法官纳撒尼尔·米切尔。

en.s: The 1807 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on October 6, 1807. The Federalist senator from Kent County George Truitt defeated the Democratic-Republican candidate Joseph Haslet.

zh.s: 1807年10月6日，特拉华州举行州长选举。联邦党候选人、肯特县参议员乔治·特鲁伊特击败民主共和党候选人约瑟夫·哈斯莱特。

en.s: Trant's raid was the Portuguese recapture of the city of Coimbra from the French on 6 October 1810 during the Peninsular War. The assault was undertaken by a Portuguese militia led by Colonel Nicholas Trant, an Irish officer in the British Army.

zh.s: 半岛战争期间，葡萄牙军队于1810年10月6日从法国人手中收复科英布拉。此次突袭由英国陆军爱尔兰军官尼古拉斯·特兰特上校率领的葡萄牙民兵实施。

en.s: The 1829 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on October 6, 1829. Incumbent Federalist Governor Charles Polk Jr. was barred from seeking re-election to a second consecutive term. David Hazzard, the two-time Democratic-Republican nominee for Governor, ran as the National Republican, or Anti-Jacksonian, candidate as the First Party System crumbled and new political parties were formed. He was opposed by Allan Thompson, the Jacksonian candidate.

zh.s: 1829年10月6日，特拉华州举行州长选举。现任联邦党州长查尔斯·波尔克二世因任期限制不能连续连任。民主共和党两届州长候选人大卫·哈扎德在第一政党体系瓦解、新政党形成之际，作为国家共和党（即反杰克逊派）候选人参选。杰克逊派候选人艾伦·汤普森与他竞争。

en.s: The 1841 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on October 6, 1841, in order to elect the Governor of Maryland. Democratic nominee and former member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Maryland's 6th district Francis Thomas narrowly defeated Whig nominee and incumbent member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Maryland's 5th district William Cost Johnson.

zh.s: 1841年10月6日，马里兰州举行州长选举。民主党候选人、前美国众议院马里兰州第六选区议员弗朗西斯·托马斯以微弱优势击败辉格党候选人、马里兰州第五选区现任众议员威廉·科斯特·约翰逊。

en.t: 1845 Florida's at-large congressional district special election
en.s: A special election to the United States House of Representatives for Florida's at-large congressional district was held October 6, 1845. The winning candidate would serve a less-than-two-year term in the United States House of Representatives to represent Florida in the 29th Congress from October 6, 1845, to March 4, 1847. The election was initially called for the Whig candidate, Edward Carrington Cabell, and Cabell was seated in the House of Representatives.

zh.t: 1845年佛罗里达州单一选区美国众议院特别选举
zh.s: 1845年10月6日，佛罗里达州单一选区举行美国众议院特别选举。胜选者将在美国众议院第29届国会代表佛罗里达州，任期不足两年，从1845年10月6日至1847年3月4日。最初宣布辉格党候选人爱德华·卡灵顿·卡贝尔获胜，卡贝尔随后进入众议院就职。

en.s: The 1845 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on October 6, 1845, to elect the governor of Georgia. The incumbent governor, George W. Crawford, was re-elected to a second term in office.

zh.s: 1845年10月6日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。现任州长乔治·W·克劳福德再次当选，开始第二个任期。

en.s: The 1847 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on October 6, 1847, in order to elect the Governor of Maryland. Democratic nominee and former member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Maryland's 2nd district Philip Francis Thomas narrowly defeated Whig nominee William Tilghman Goldsborough.

zh.s: 1847年10月6日，马里兰州举行州长选举。民主党候选人、前美国众议院马里兰州第二选区议员菲利普·弗朗西斯·托马斯以微弱优势击败辉格党候选人威廉·蒂尔曼·戈兹伯勒。

en.s: The 1851 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on October 6, 1851, to elect the governor of Georgia. Howell Cobb, nominee for the newly formed Constitutional Union Party, defeated the Resistance candidate, Charles McDonald.

zh.s: 1851年10月6日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。新成立的宪政联盟党候选人豪厄尔·科布击败抵抗党候选人查尔斯·麦克唐纳。

en.t: Great fire of Newcastle and Gateshead
en.s: The Great fire of Newcastle and Gateshead was a tragic and spectacular series of events starting on Friday 6 October 1854, in which a substantial amount of property in the two North East of England towns was destroyed in a series of fires and an explosion which killed 53 and injured hundreds. There is only one building still extant on the Newcastle Quayside which predated the fire.

zh.t: 纽卡斯尔和盖茨黑德大火
zh.s: 1854年10月6日（星期五），英国东北部纽卡斯尔和盖茨黑德两座城镇发生一系列火灾和爆炸，造成大面积财产损失。53人死亡，数百人受伤。纽卡斯尔码头区现存的建筑中，只有一座早于这场大火。

en.s: The 1856 Florida gubernatorial election was held on October 6, 1856. Democratic Nominee Madison S. Perry defeated Know Nothing candidate David S. Walker. The Election was decided by 320 votes.

zh.s: 1856年10月6日，佛罗里达州举行州长选举。民主党候选人麦迪逊·S·佩里击败一无所知党候选人大卫·S·沃克，票差为320票。

en.s: The 1856 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on October 6, 1856, in order to elect the Governor of Indiana. Incumbent Democratic Lieutenant Governor of Indiana Ashbel P. Willard defeated People's Party nominee Oliver P. Morton.

zh.s: 1856年10月6日，印第安纳州举行州长选举。民主党籍现任副州长阿什贝尔·P·威拉德击败人民党候选人奥利弗·P·莫顿。

en.s: The 1857 East Torrens colonial by-election was held on 6 October 1857 to elect one of two members for East Torrens in the South Australian House of Assembly, after sitting member George Marsden Waterhouse resigned on 8 September 1857. Lavington Glyde won the by-election with 51 per cent of the vote.

zh.t: 1857年东托伦斯选区殖民地补选
zh.s: 1857年10月6日，南澳大利亚州议会东托伦斯选区举行补选，选出两名议员中的一名。乔治·马斯登·沃特豪斯于1857年9月8日辞去议员职务，因此举行补选。拉文顿·格莱德以51%的得票率获胜。

en.s: The 1862 Arkansas gubernatorial election was the ninth gubernatorial election, held on Monday, October 6, 1862. In the midst of the American Civil War, Colonel Harris Flanagin easily defeated incumbent Governor Henry M. Rector and Independent candidate John S. H. Rainey with 68.06% of the vote. Flanagin took office as the seventh governor on November 15, 1862. It was the only gubernatorial election conducted following the adoption of Arkansas's second constitution.

zh.s: 1862年10月6日（星期一），阿肯色州举行第9次州长选举。美国内战期间，哈里斯·弗拉纳金上校以68.06%的得票率轻松击败现任州长亨利·M·雷克托和独立候选人约翰·S·H·雷尼。弗拉纳金于1862年11月15日就任第7任州长。这是该州通过第二部宪法后举行的唯一一次州长选举。

en.s: The Battle of Baxter Springs, more commonly known as the Baxter Springs Massacre, was a minor battle of the American Civil War, fought on October 6, 1863, near the present-day town of Baxter Springs, Kansas. In late 1863, Quantrill's Raiders, a large Confederate guerrilla band, was traveling south through Kansas along the Texas Road to winter in Texas. Numbering about 400, this group captured and killed two Union teamsters who had come from a small Federal Army post called Fort Blair (frequently referred to as Fort Baxter).

zh.t: 巴克斯特斯普林斯战役
zh.s: 巴克斯特斯普林斯战役又常称巴克斯特斯普林斯大屠杀，是美国内战期间的一场小规模战斗，于1863年10月6日在今堪萨斯州巴克斯特斯普林斯镇附近爆发。1863年末，夸特里尔突袭队这支规模较大的南方邦联游击队正沿德克萨斯路向南穿过堪萨斯，准备到德克萨斯过冬。队伍约有400人，抓住并杀害了两名从一个小型联邦军哨所布莱尔堡（常称巴克斯特堡）前来的联邦军辎重人员。

en.s: The Battle of Bonari Pass (Japanese:母成峠の戦い) was part of the Boshin War, and occurred on the 6 October 1868 (Gregorian Calendar), or the 21st day of the Eighth Month, Keiō-4 year (Japanese calendar). The Bonari pass was a strategic access at the limit of the fief of Aizu. The battle opposed a mixed force of 700 troops- including former shogunate soldiers (Denshutai and Shinsengumi) led by Otori Keisuke and Hijikata Toshizo, Aizu forces, and soldiers of various northern domains- to 2,000 troops favourable to the Imperial government. Outnumbered, the shogunal troops had to retreat to the North to Sendai, where the fleet of Enomoto Takeaki was ready to evacuate them to Hokkaidō.

zh.s: 母成峠之战（日语：母成峠の戦い）是戊辰战争的一部分，发生于1868年10月6日（公历），即庆应四年八月二十一日（日本历）。母成峠是会津藩领地边界上的战略通道。700名守军与2000名亲帝国政府军队交战。守军包括大鸟圭介和土方岁三率领的幕府旧军（传习队和新选组）、会津藩军以及北方各藩士兵。由于人数居于劣势，幕府军撤往北方仙台；榎本武扬率领的舰队已准备好将他们撤至北海道。

en.s: The Battle of Aizu (Japanese: 会津戦争, romanized: Aizu sensō, lit. 'War of Aizu') was fought in northern Japan from October to November in autumn 1868, and was part of the Boshin War.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 会津战争（日语：会津戦争，转写：Aizu sensō）于1868年秋季10月至11月在日本北部爆发，是戊辰战争的一部分。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Nompatelize, also known as the Battle of Etival, was a battle of the Franco-Prussian War on 6 October 1870, between Etival and Nompatelize in the province of Vosges from Strasbourg 64 km southwest. This battle marked the first major crackdown of franc-tireur operations in the Vosges region by the XIV Corps of the Prussians by Minister August von Werder in early October 1870.

zh.s: 1870年10月6日，普法战争期间，诺姆帕特利兹战役又称埃蒂瓦尔战役，发生在孚日省埃蒂瓦尔与诺姆帕特利兹之间，距斯特拉斯堡西南64公里。这场战斗标志着普鲁士第14军于1870年10月初首次大规模镇压孚日地区自由射手队的行动。

en.s: The Battle of Charasiab was fought on 6 October 1879 during the Second Anglo-Afghan War between British and Indian troops against Afghan forces. The British were led by Major-General Sir Frederick Roberts, then commander of the Kabul Field Force, and the Afghans by Nek Mohammed Khan, Governor of Kabul and uncle of Yakub Khan, the former Amir.

zh.s: 1879年10月6日，第二次英阿战争期间，英印军队与阿富汗军队在查拉西亚布交战。英军由喀布尔野战部队司令弗雷德里克·罗伯茨少将爵士率领，阿富汗军队则由喀布尔省长、前埃米尔雅库布汗的叔叔内克·穆罕默德汗指挥。

en.s: The 1880 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on October 6, 1880, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee and incumbent Governor Alfred H. Colquitt defeated Independent Democratic nominee and former United States Senator from Georgia Thomas M. Norwood.

zh.s: 1880年10月6日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。民主党候选人、现任州长阿尔弗雷德·H·科尔奎特击败独立民主党候选人、前联邦参议员托马斯·M·诺伍德。

en.t: The United States establishes the Naval War College
en.s: On October 6, 1884, Secretary of the Navy William E. Chandler signed General Order 325 establishing the Naval War College in Newport, Rhode Island.

zh.t: 美国设立海军战争学院
zh.s: 1884年10月6日，美国海军部长威廉·钱德勒签署第325号命令，在罗得岛州纽波特设立海军战争学院。

en.s: The 1886 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on October 6, 1886, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee, former United States Senator from Georgia and candidate for Governor in the 1868 election John B. Gordon ran unopposed and thus won the election.

zh.s: 1886年10月6日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。民主党候选人、前联邦参议员约翰·B·戈登没有对手，因而当选。戈登曾在1868年竞选州长。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 22 September and 6 October 1889 during the Boulanger affair. They resulted in a victory for the Republicans, and a thorough defeat for the Boulangists.

zh.s: 1889年9月22日和10月6日，法国举行立法选举，正值布朗热事件期间。共和党获胜，布朗热派遭到彻底击败。

en.s: The 1896 Florida gubernatorial election was held on October 6, 1896. Democratic nominee William D. Bloxham defeated Republican nominee Edward R. Gunby with 66.55% of the vote.

zh.s: 1896年10月6日，佛罗里达州举行州长选举。民主党候选人威廉·D·布洛克瑟姆以66.55%的得票率击败共和党候选人爱德华·R·冈比。

en.t: Phi Mu Alpha Sinfonia, the largest American music fraternity, is founded at the New England Conservatory of Music
en.s: Phi Mu Alpha Sinfonia (ΦΜΑ) is an American collegiate social fraternity with an emphasis in music. It was founded as the Sinfonia Club at the New England Conservatory of Music on October 6, 1898, by Ossian Everett Mills. The fraternity is open to men "who, through a love for music, can assist in the fulfillment of [its] object and ideals either by adopting music as a profession or by working to advance the cause of music in America."

zh.s: ΦΜΑ交响乐兄弟会是美国一所大学社交兄弟会，关注音乐。1898年10月6日，奥西安·埃弗里特·米尔斯在新英格兰音乐学院创立该组织，名称为交响乐俱乐部。兄弟会向热爱音乐的男性开放；他们可以以音乐为业，或致力于推动美国音乐事业，以实现该组织的宗旨和理想。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Portugal on 6 October 1901, the third in three years. The result was a victory for the Regeneration Party, which won 100 seats.

zh.s: 1901年10月6日，葡萄牙举行议会选举，这是3年内举行的第三次。复兴党获胜，赢得100席。

en.s: The Battle of Erego (also known as Beerdhiga) occurred on October 6, 1902, in Hodayo, about 70 miles north of Galkacyo. The battle involved British colonial forces, led by Colonel Swayne, and Somali troops (known as Dervishes) under the command of Haji Muhammad Abdullah Hassan. The Dervishes won by ambushing the British forces. The battle was an early conflict of the Dervish War.

zh.s: 埃雷戈战役又称贝尔迪加战役，于1902年10月6日在霍达约爆发，地点距加尔卡约以北约70英里。斯韦恩上校率领的英国殖民军与哈吉·穆罕默德·阿卜杜拉·哈桑指挥的索马里军队（称为“德尔维希”）交战。德尔维希军队设伏击败英军。这是德尔维希战争初期的一场冲突。

en.s: The 1911 North Tyrone by-election was a Parliamentary by-election. North Tyrone returned one Member of Parliament (MP) to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, elected by the first past the post voting system. The by-election was held on 6 October 1911.

zh.s: 1911年10月6日，英国议会北蒂龙选区举行补选。该选区采用简单多数制，选出一名议员进入英国下议院。

en.s: The 1913 FA Charity Shield was the sixth staging of the FA Charity Shield, an annual association football match arranged to raise funds for charitable causes supported by the Football Association (the FA), the governing body of football in England. The match was contested by select teams of amateur and professional players. It was played on 6 October 1913 at The Den, London, and ended as a 7–2 win for the Professionals. England internationals Harry Hampton scored four goals, George Holley two and Harold Fleming one for the Professionals; George Barlow and Herbert Farnfield scored for the Amateurs.

zh.s: 1913年英格兰足总慈善盾杯是该赛事第6届比赛。这项年度足球比赛由英格兰足球总会组织，为其支持的慈善事业筹款。本届由业余和职业球员的选拔队对阵。比赛于1913年10月6日在伦敦的丹球场举行，职业队以7比2获胜。英格兰国脚哈里·汉普顿为职业队打入4球，乔治·霍利打入2球，哈罗德·弗莱明打入1球；业余队由乔治·巴洛和赫伯特·法恩菲尔德进球。

en.s: The 1918 Svenska Mästerskapet final was played on 6 October 1918 between the three-time finalists IFK Göteborg and the first-time finalists Helsingborgs IF. The match decided the winner of 1918 Svenska Mästerskapet, the football cup to determine the Swedish champions. IFK Göteborg won their third title with a 5–0 victory.

zh.s: 1918年瑞典足球锦标赛决赛于1918年10月6日举行，由三次打入决赛的哥德堡IFK队对阵首次进入决赛的赫尔辛堡IF队。这场比赛决出1918年瑞典足球锦标赛冠军。哥德堡IFK队以5比0获胜，第三次夺冠。

en.s: The Starobilsk agreement was a 1920 political and military alliance between the Makhnovshchina, an anarchist mass movement led by Nestor Makhno's Insurgent Army, and the Ukrainian Soviet Socialist Republic, which the Bolsheviks had established as the government of Ukraine. The agreement was reached following the resurgence of the White movement in Ukraine, which forced the warring Bolshevik and Makhnovist factions to put aside their differences and work together against their common enemy.
en.n: Ukrainian War of Independence: The Starobilsk agreement is signed by representatives of the Ukrainian Soviet Socialist Republic and the Makhnovshchina.

zh.s: 斯塔罗比尔斯克协定是1920年乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国与马赫诺运动之间的政治和军事联盟。马赫诺运动是由内斯托尔·马赫诺的起义军领导的无政府主义群众运动；乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国则是布尔什维克建立的乌克兰政府。白军在乌克兰势力复起后，交战中的布尔什维克和马赫诺派被迫搁置分歧，共同对付敌人。
zh.n: 乌克兰独立战争：乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国与马赫诺运动的代表签署《斯塔罗比尔斯克协定》。

en.s: The 1924 FA Charity Shield was the eleventh staging of the FA Charity Shield, an annual association football match arranged to raise funds for charitable causes supported by the Football Association (the FA), the governing body of football in England. As in the 1923 competition, the match was held between the a team of England professionals and amateurs.

en.s: The 1926 FA Charity Shield was the thirteenth staging of the FA Charity Shield, an annual association football match arranged to raise funds for charitable causes supported by the Football Association (the FA), the governing body of football in England. For the fifth time, the match was contested by select teams of amateur and professional players. It was played on 6 October 1926 at Maine Road, Manchester, and ended as a 6–3 win for the Amateurs. Wilfred Minter and Frank Macey each scored twice, Edgar Kail once, and an own goal by Michael Keeping completed the Amateurs' scoring; Bill Rawlings scored twice and Fred Tunstall scored once for the Professionals.

zh.s: 1926年英格兰足总慈善盾杯是该赛事第13届比赛。这项年度足球比赛由英格兰足球总会组织，为其支持的慈善事业筹款。这是业余和职业球员选拔队第五次参赛。比赛于1926年10月6日在曼彻斯特缅因路球场举行，业余队以6比3获胜。威尔弗雷德·明特和弗兰克·梅西各进2球，埃德加·凯尔进1球，迈克尔·基平的乌龙球也为业余队添分；职业队由比尔·罗林斯进2球，弗雷德·滕斯托尔进1球。

zh.s: 佐治亚州民主党举行州长初选决选，因为县单位制下的首轮投票没有候选人获得多数。

en.t: Revolution of 1934: The President of the autonomous government of Catalonia, Lluís Companys, proclaims the Catalan State with the support of the Worker's Alliance
en.s: The events of 6 October (Catalan: Fets del sis d'octubre) were a general strike, armed insurgency and declaration of a Catalan State in Catalonia during the Revolution of 1934 on 6 October 1934. The predominantly left-wing Generalitat of Catalonia led by President Lluís Companys declared the Catalan State in reaction to the inclusion of the right-wing CEDA party in the Spanish Republican government of Alejandro Lerroux.

zh.t: 1934年革命：加泰罗尼亚自治政府主席路易斯·孔帕尼斯在工人联盟支持下宣布成立加泰罗尼亚国
zh.s: 1934年10月6日，加泰罗尼亚发生总罢工、武装起义和宣布建立加泰罗尼亚国等事件，是1934年革命的一部分。以左翼人士为主的加泰罗尼亚自治政府由主席路易斯·孔帕尼斯领导。由于右翼长枪党西班牙自治权利联盟加入亚历杭德罗·莱鲁克斯领导的西班牙共和国政府，孔帕尼斯宣布成立加泰罗尼亚国。

en.s: The 1937 Ontario general election was held on October 6, 1937, to elect the 90 Members of the 20th Legislative Assembly of Ontario ("MLAs"). It was the 20th general election held in the province of Ontario.

zh.s: 1937年10月6日，安大略省举行大选，选出第20届省议会的90名议员。这是安大略省举行的第20次大选。

en.s: The Soviet invasion of Poland was a military conflict by the Soviet Union without a formal declaration of war. On 17 September 1939, the Soviet Union invaded Poland from the east, 16 days after Nazi Germany invaded Poland from the west. Subsequent military operations lasted for the following 20 days and ended on 6 October 1939 with the two-way division and annexation of the entire territory of the Second Polish Republic by Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union.

zh.s: 苏联入侵波兰是苏联在未正式宣战的情况下发动的一场军事冲突。1939年9月17日，纳粹德国从西部入侵波兰16天后，苏联从东部入侵波兰。此后军事行动持续20天，并于1939年10月6日结束；纳粹德国和苏联瓜分并吞并了波兰第二共和国的全部领土。

en.t: Kleeberg’s forces surrender after the Battle of Kock
en.s: On October 6, 1939, General Franciszek Kleeberg’s Independent Operational Group Polesie surrendered to German forces after the fighting near Kock, Poland, having run out of ammunition.
en.n: This records the surrender, following Kleeberg’s decision the previous evening.

zh.t: 克莱贝格部队在科克战役后投降
zh.s: 1939年10月6日，弗兰齐歇克·克莱贝格将军指挥的波莱谢独立作战集群因弹药耗尽，在波兰科克附近的战斗后向德军投降。

en.s: The Battle of Vella Lavella (第二次ベララベラ海戦, Dainiji Berarabera kaisen) was a naval battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II fought on the night of 6 October 1943, near the island of Vella Lavella in the Solomon Islands. It marked the end of a three-month fight to capture the central Solomon Islands, as part of the Solomon Islands campaign.

zh.s: 维拉拉维拉海战（日语：第二次ベララベラ海戦）是第二次世界大战太平洋战场的一场海战，于1943年10月6日晚在所罗门群岛维拉拉维拉岛附近爆发。这场海战标志着为夺取所罗门群岛中部而进行的3个月战斗结束，也是所罗门群岛战役的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Vella Lavella was fought from 15 August – 6 October 1943 between the Empire of Japan and the Allied forces from New Zealand and the United States at the end of the New Georgia campaign. Vella Lavella, an island located in the Solomon Islands, had been occupied by Japanese forces early during the war in the Pacific.

en.s: The Battle of the Dukla Pass, also known as the Dukla, Carpatho–Dukla, Rzeszów–Dukla, or Dukla–Prešov offensive, was the battle for control over the Dukla Pass on the border between Poland and Slovakia on the Eastern Front of World War II between Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union in September–October 1944. It was part of the Soviet east Carpathian strategic offensive that also included the Carpathian–Uzhgorod offensive.
en.n: World War II: Units of the 1st Czechoslovak Army Corps enter Czechoslovakia during the Battle of the Dukla Pass.

zh.s: 杜克拉山口战役又称杜克拉、喀尔巴阡—杜克拉、热舒夫—杜克拉或杜克拉—普雷绍夫攻势，是第二次世界大战东线的一场战役。1944年9月至10月，纳粹德国与苏联在波兰和斯洛伐克边境争夺杜克拉山口控制权。该战役是苏联东喀尔巴阡山脉战略攻势的一部分，也包括喀尔巴阡—乌日哥罗德攻势。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战：第一捷克斯洛伐克军团部队在杜克拉山口战役期间进入捷克斯洛伐克。

zh.s: 1946年全爱尔兰高级盖尔式足球锦标赛决赛是第59届全爱尔兰决赛，也是该届锦标赛的冠军决胜赛。这项赛事由爱尔兰各郡的顶尖球队参加。

en.s: The 1948 FA Charity Shield was the 26th Charity Shield, an annual English association football match played between the winners of the previous season's Football League and FA Cup. It was the first edition held since the postponement of football during the Second World War. The match, held at Highbury on 6 October 1948, was contested by Arsenal, champions of the 1947–48 Football League and Manchester United, who beat Blackpool in the final of the 1947–48 FA Cup.

zh.s: 1948年英格兰足总慈善盾杯是第26届慈善盾杯，是英格兰每年举行的足球比赛，由上赛季足球联赛和足总杯冠军参加。这是第二次世界大战期间足球赛事暂停后首次恢复举办。比赛于1948年10月6日在海布里举行，由1947—1948赛季足球联赛冠军阿森纳对阵足总杯冠军曼彻斯特联；曼联在决赛中击败了布莱克浦。

en.s: Central Tibet came under the control of the People's Republic of China (PRC) after the government of Tibet signed the Seventeen Point Agreement which the 14th Dalai Lama ratified on 24 October 1951. The Chinese government calls the signing of the agreement the "Peaceful Liberation of Tibet". The events are called the "Chinese invasion of Tibet" by the exiled Central Tibetan Administration and much of the Tibetan diaspora.

en.s: On October 6, 1951, British High Commissioner Henry Gurney was killed by communist guerrillas in an ambush on the road to Fraser’s Hill in Malaya, in what is now Malaysia.

This year's match was contested by league champions Wolverhampton Wanderers and FA Cup winners Bolton Wanderers. The match was staged at Bolton's home ground, Burnden Park. The hosts won the game 4–1, giving them their only Shield win.

en.s: Operation Badr (Arabic: عملية بدر ʻAmaliyat Badr), also known as Plan Badr (خطة بدر Khitat Badr), was an Egyptian military offensive and operation across the Suez Canal that destroyed the Bar-Lev Line, a chain of Israeli fortifications along the frontline of the Israeli-occupied Sinai Peninsula, on 6 October 1973. It was launched in conjunction with a Syrian military offensive against the Israeli-occupied Golan Heights, triggering the Yom Kippur War.

zh.s: 巴德尔行动（阿拉伯语：عملية بدر，转写：ʻAmaliyat Badr）又称“巴德尔计划”（阿拉伯语：خطة بدر，转写：Khitat Badr），是埃及军队于1973年10月6日发动的军事进攻，越过苏伊士运河并摧毁以色列占领的西奈半岛前线防御工事“巴列夫防线”。埃军发动行动的同时，叙利亚军队进攻以色列占领的戈兰高地，由此引发赎罪日战争。

en.s: The Yom Kippur War, also known as the 1973 Arab–Israeli War, the fourth Arab–Israeli War, the October War, or the Ramadan War (6–25 October 1973), was fought between Israel and a coalition of Arab states led by Egypt and Syria. Most of the fighting occurred in the Sinai Peninsula and the Golan Heights, territories occupied by Israel in 1967. Some combat also took place in mainland Egypt and northern Israel.

zh.s: 赎罪日战争又称1973年阿以战争、第四次阿以战争、十月战争或斋月战争，于1973年10月6日至25日爆发，交战双方为以色列与埃及、叙利亚等阿拉伯国家组成的联盟。主要战斗发生在西奈半岛和戈兰高地，这些地区于1967年被以色列占领。埃及本土和以色列北部也发生了部分战斗。

en.s: The Ofira Air Battle was one of the first air battles of the Yom Kippur War. On 6 October 1973, Egypt launched a massive surprise attack on Israel that included over 200 Egyptian aircraft participating in an opening airstrike. The Israeli Air Force (IAF) Base Ofira at Sharm el-Sheikh came under attack by 20 Egyptian Air Force MiG-17s and their eight MiG-21 escorts.

zh.s: 奥菲拉空战是赎罪日战争初期的空战之一。1973年10月6日，埃及发动大规模突袭，包括200多架埃及飞机参与首轮空袭。位于沙姆沙伊赫的以色列空军奥菲拉基地遭到20架米格-17战斗机及其8架米格-21护航机攻击。

en.s: The Battle of Fort Lahtzanit took place on October 6, 1973, between the Egyptian Army and the Israel Defense Forces (IDF). Part of the Egyptian-initiated Operation Badr, the battle was one of the first of the Yom Kippur War, fought in and around Fort Lahtzanit, a fortification of the Bar Lev Line, located 19 kilometres (12 mi) south of Port Fouad in the Sinai Peninsula.

zh.s: 1973年10月6日，埃及军队与以色列国防军在拉赫扎尼特堡交战。这是埃及发动的巴德尔行动和赎罪日战争初期的战斗之一，战斗发生在西奈半岛巴列夫防线上的拉赫扎尼特堡及其周边，距塞得港以南19公里（12英里）。

en.s: The Battles of Fort Budapest (Hebrew: מעוז בודפשט) refer to two attempts by the Egyptian Army to capture Fort Budapest, part of Israel's Bar Lev Line, during the Yom Kippur War. The first attempt took place at noon on October 6, 1973, with the start of Operation Badr, but failed due to Israeli Air Force intervention.

zh.s: “布达佩斯堡战役”指埃及军队在赎罪日战争期间两次试图攻占以色列巴列夫防线一部分布达佩斯堡的行动。第一次进攻于1973年10月6日中午、巴德尔行动开始时发起，但因以色列空军介入而失败。

en.s: The 6 October 1976 massacre, also known as the 6 October event (Thai: เหตุการณ์ 6 ตุลา RTGS: het kan hok tula) in Thailand, was a violent crackdown by Thai police and lynching by right-wing paramilitaries and bystanders against leftist protesters who had occupied Bangkok's Thammasat University and the adjacent Sanam Luang, on 6 October 1976.

zh.s: 1976年10月6日，泰国警察与右翼准军事组织及旁观者对左翼抗议者实施暴力镇压和私刑，史称1976年10月6日大屠杀，也称“10月6日事件”（泰语：เหตุการณ์ 6 ตุลา，皇家转写：het kan hok tula）。左翼抗议者占据了曼谷法政大学及相邻的皇家田广场。

en.s: Cubana de Aviación Flight 455 was an international Cuban flight from Barbados to Jamaica that was brought down on 6 October 1976 by a terrorist bomb attack. All 73 people on board the Douglas DC-8 aircraft were killed after two time bombs went off and the plane crashed into the sea. The crash killed every member of the Cuban national fencing team.

zh.s: 1976年10月6日，一架古巴航空国际航班从巴巴多斯飞往牙买加途中遭恐怖袭击，一枚炸弹将其炸毁。道格拉斯DC-8飞机上73人全部遇难，两枚定时炸弹爆炸后，飞机坠入海中。遇难者包括古巴国家击剑队全体成员。

en.s: On October 6, 1976, Gerald Ford and Jimmy Carter held their second presidential debate at the Palace of Fine Arts in San Francisco. The debate focused on foreign and defense policy.

en.s: Elections to the Madhya Pradesh Legislative Assembly were held in October 1977. The Janata Party won a majority of seats and Kailash Chandra Joshi was sworn in as the new chief minister. The number of constituencies in Madhya Pradesh were increased to 320, following the recommendation of the Delimitation Commission of India.

zh.s: 中央邦立法议会选举于1977年10月举行。人民党赢得多数席位，凯拉什·钱德拉·乔希宣誓就任新任首席部长。根据印度划界委员会的建议，中央邦选区数量增至320个。

en.s: Operation Miracle, or the Battle of Mavonde, was a military raid in 1979 by the Rhodesian Security Forces (RSF) against ZANLA guerrilla bases in Mozambique towards the end of the Rhodesian Bush War. ZANLA put up stiff resistance, although at the cost of many losses with as many as hundreds dead. The tactical success of the RSF did not lead to the expected strategic changes but did result in a decisive tactical victory with few losses.

zh.s: 奇迹行动又称马冯德战役，是罗得西亚安全部队于1979年发动的一次军事突袭，目标是位于莫桑比克的津巴布韦非洲民族解放军游击队基地。津巴布韦非洲民族解放军进行了顽强抵抗，伤亡惨重，死亡人数可能多达数百人。罗得西亚安全部队取得战术胜利，但损失不大；行动没有带来预期的战略变化。

en.s: The Ugandan Bush War was a civil war fought in Uganda by the official Ugandan government and its armed wing, the Uganda National Liberation Army (UNLA), against a number of rebel groups, most importantly the National Resistance Army (NRA), from 1980 to 1986. The unpopular President Milton Obote was overthrown in a coup d'état in 1971 by General Idi Amin, who established a military dictatorship.

zh.s: 1980年至1986年，乌干达政府及其武装力量乌干达民族解放军（UNLA）与多个反叛组织交战，其中主要对手是民族抵抗军（NRA）。不受欢迎的总统米尔顿·奥博特于1971年被伊迪·阿明将军发动政变推翻；阿明随后建立了军事独裁统治。

en.s: NLM CityHopper Flight 431 was a flight by a Fokker F-28-4000, registration PH-CHI, that was operating an international scheduled Rotterdam–Eindhoven–Hamburg passenger service. On 6 October 1981, the aircraft encountered a tornado on the first leg, minutes after taking off from Rotterdam Airport, and crashed 15 miles (24 km) south-southeast of Rotterdam. All 17 occupants of the aircraft – 13 passengers and 4 crew members– died in the accident.

zh.t: NLM城市跳线航空431号班机空难
zh.s: 1981年10月6日，NLM城市跳线航空431号班机从鹿特丹飞往埃因霍温和汉堡，执行国际定期客运航班。该机为福克F-28-4000型飞机，注册号PH-CHI。起飞数分钟后，在第一段航程中遭遇龙卷风，随后在鹿特丹以南偏东南15英里（24公里）处坠毁。机上17人全部遇难，其中13名乘客、4名机组人员。

zh.s: 1981年10月6日，埃及总统安瓦尔·萨达特在开罗的一场阅兵式上遭埃及伊斯兰圣战组织成员刺杀身亡。

en.s: The 1981 Atlanta Mayoral Election took place on October 6, 1981, with the runoff held on October 27. Mayor Maynard Jackson was ineligible to run due to term limits. The runoff featured two prominent Atlanta politicians: former Congressman and United States in United Nations Ambassador Andrew Young and State Representative Sidney Marcus. Young won in the October 27th runoff by double digits.

zh.s: 1981年10月6日，亚特兰大举行市长选举，10月27日举行决选。现任市长梅纳德·杰克逊因任期限制不能参选。决选由两名亚特兰大知名政治人物参加：前国会议员、美国驻联合国大使安德鲁·杨，以及州众议员西德尼·马库斯。杨在10月27日的决选中以两位数优势获胜。

en.s: The 1981 Nova Scotia general election was held on October 6, 1981, to elect members of the 53rd House of Assembly of the province of Nova Scotia, Canada. It was won by the Progressive Conservative party.

zh.s: 1981年10月6日，新斯科舍省举行大选，选出加拿大新斯科舍省第53届省议会议员。进步保守党获胜。

en.s: The 1985 Portuguese legislative election took place on 6 October. The election renewed all 250 members of the Assembly of the Republic. The election was called after the resignation, in June 1985, of Socialist Party (PS) Prime Minister Mário Soares, following the withdrawal of the center-right Social Democratic Party (PSD) from the Central Bloc government. Soares didn't contest the election, deciding to run for the January 1986 Presidential elections instead.

zh.s: 1985年10月6日，葡萄牙举行议会选举，改选共和国议会全部250名议员。1985年6月，社会党（PS）总理马里奥·苏亚雷斯辞职；中右翼社会民主党（PSD）随后退出中央集团联合政府，因此举行此次选举。苏亚雷斯没有参加大选，转而竞选1986年1月的总统选举。

zh.s: 1990年10月6日，路易斯安那州举行美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任联邦参议员小J·贝内特·约翰斯顿成功连任第四个任期，并避免了决选。

en.s: The 1990 Shreveport mayoral election resulted in the election of Republican councilwoman Hazel Beard in the race to succeed the term limited incumbent, John Brennan Hussey. The primary election was held on October 6, 1990. Beard and C. O. Simpkins, a dentist and civil rights activist, advanced to the general election held on November 6, 1990. Beard became the first woman, and the first Republican since Reconstruction, to serve as mayor of Shreveport.

zh.s: 1990年什里夫波特市长选举选出了共和党市议员黑兹尔·比尔德，接替受任期限制的现任市长约翰·布伦南·赫西。初选于1990年10月6日举行，比尔德和牙医、民权活动家C·O·西姆金斯进入11月6日举行的普选。比尔德成为该市首位女性市长，也是重建时期以来首位共和党籍市长。

en.t: Discovery launches on STS-41 carrying Ulysses

zh.t: 发现号航天飞机搭载尤利西斯号升空

en.s: The 1991 Portuguese legislative election took place on 6 October. The election renewed all 230 members of the Assembly of the Republic. For the first time in Portuguese democracy, an election was held after the four years of the legislature had been fully completed.

en.s: Operation Corridor 92 (Serbian: Операција Коридор 92, Operacija Koridor 92) was an operation conducted during the Bosnian War by the Army of Republika Srpska (VRS) against the forces of the Croatian Defence Council (HVO) and the Croatian Army (HV) in northern Bosnia and Herzegovina between 24 June and 6 October 1992. The objective of the offensive was to re-establish a road link between the city of Banja Luka in the west of the country and the eastern parts of the territory controlled by the Bosnian Serbs.

zh.s: 走廊92行动（塞尔维亚语：Операција Коридор 92，转写：Operacija Koridor 92）是波斯尼亚战争期间塞族共和国军（VRS）针对克罗地亚国防委员会（HVO）和克罗地亚军队（HV）在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那北部开展的一次军事行动，持续时间为1992年6月24日至10月6日。进攻目标是重新打通该国西部巴尼亚卢卡与波黑塞族控制区东部之间的公路连接。

en.s: General elections were held in Pakistan on 6 October 1993. The election took place after both the Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif and President Ghulam Ishaq Khan resigned to resolve a power struggle between them. Although the Pakistan Muslim League (N) won the largest number of votes, the Pakistan Peoples Party won the most seats. After winning the support of minor parties and independents the leader of the PPP, Benazir Bhutto, was elected Prime Minister by the National Assembly. Voter turnout was 40.3%.

zh.s: 1993年10月6日，巴基斯坦举行大选。总理纳瓦兹·谢里夫和总统吴拉姆·伊沙克·汗均辞职后举行此次选举，以解决两人之间的权力斗争。尽管巴基斯坦穆斯林联盟（谢里夫派）获得的选票最多，巴基斯坦人民党赢得的席位最多。人民党领袖贝娜齐尔·布托获得小党和独立议员支持后，由国民议会选为总理。投票率为40.3%。

en.s: General elections were held in Islamabad Capital Territory on Wednesday 6 October 1993 to elect 1 member of National Assembly of Pakistan from Islamabad. Pakistan Muslim League (N) won Islamabad seat by the margin of 9,790 votes.

zh.s: 1993年10月6日（星期三），巴基斯坦伊斯兰堡首都区举行大选，选出1名国民议会议员。巴基斯坦穆斯林联盟（谢里夫派）以9790票的优势赢得伊斯兰堡席位。

en.t: Mayor and Queloz announce the discovery of 51 Pegasi b
en.s: On October 6, 1995, Michel Mayor and Didier Queloz announced the discovery of the exoplanet 51 Pegasi b at a conference in Florence, Italy.
en.n: This is the public announcement date, rather than the date of the first observations.

zh.t: 马约尔与奎洛兹宣布发现飞马座51 b
zh.s: 1995年10月6日，米歇尔·马约尔和迪迪埃·奎洛兹在意大利佛罗伦萨的一场会议上，宣布发现系外行星飞马座51 b。
zh.n: 这里记录的是公开宣布的日期，并非首次观测到信号的日期。

en.s: The 1996 NSL Cup final (October) was the final match of the 1996–97 NSL Cup, the 21st and final season of the National Soccer League Cup. It was played at Bob Jane Stadium in Melbourne on 6 October 1996 between Collingwood Warriors and Marconi Fairfield. Collingwood Warriors won the match 1–0 for their first NSL Cup title.

zh.s: 1996年国家足球联赛杯决赛（10月）是1996—1997赛季国家足球联赛杯的决赛，也是该项赛事第21届、最后一届。比赛于1996年10月6日在墨尔本的鲍勃·简球场举行，由科林伍德勇士队对阵马可尼费尔菲尔德队。科林伍德勇士队以1比0获胜，首次夺得国家足球联赛杯。

en.s: The 1996 Liga Indonesia Premier Division final was a football match which was played on 6 October 1996 at Gelora Senayan Main Stadium in Jakarta. It was contested by PSM and Bandung Raya to determine the winner of the 1995–96 Liga Indonesia Premier Division. Bandung Raya won the match 2–0 to claim their first-ever title.

zh.s: 1996年印尼甲级联赛决赛于1996年10月6日在雅加达格罗拉·蓬卡诺主体育场举行，由PSM队对阵万隆拉亚队，决出1995—1996赛季印尼甲级联赛冠军。万隆拉亚队以2比0获胜，首次夺冠。

en.t: Clinton and Dole hold their first presidential debate
en.s: On October 6, 1996, Bill Clinton and Bob Dole held their first presidential debate at the Bushnell in Hartford, Connecticut.

zh.t: 克林顿与多尔举行首场总统候选人辩论
zh.s: 1996年10月6日，比尔·克林顿与鲍勃·多尔在美国康涅狄格州哈特福德的布什内尔剧院举行首场总统候选人辩论。

en.s: The Leyenda de Plata (2000) was professional wrestling tournament produced by the Mexican wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLLl; Spanish "World Wrestling Council") that ran from September 22, 2000, over the course of three of CMLL's Friday night shows in Arena México with the finals on October 6, 2000. The annual Leyenda de Plata tournament is held in honor of lucha libre legend El Santo and is one of CMLL's most important annual tournaments.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2000年银色传奇摔角赛是由墨西哥摔角联盟世界摔角理事会（CMLL）举办的职业摔角锦标赛，从2000年9月22日开始，在墨西哥竞技场举行的三场周五晚赛事中进行，决赛于10月6日举行。银色传奇赛每年举办一次，以纪念摔角传奇人物埃尔·圣托，是CMLL最重要的年度赛事之一。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框标注的日期。

en.s: On 6 October 2001, France hosted Algeria in an international friendly in Saint-Denis' Stade de France. It was the first time France played against Algeria after the latter gained independence from the former in 1962. Both Algerian and French players were presented as 'messengers of peace' before the start of the game but the French national anthem was booed by many of the fans.

zh.t: 2001年法国对阵阿尔及利亚足球赛
zh.s: 2001年10月6日，法国在圣但尼的法兰西体育场主场迎战阿尔及利亚，进行一场国际友谊赛。这是阿尔及利亚于1962年脱离法国独立后，两国首次进行足球比赛。赛前，双方球员被称为“和平使者”，但许多球迷在比赛中嘘法国国歌。

en.s: The Maranhão gubernatorial election, 2002 was held in the Brazilian state of Maranhão on October 6, alongside Brazil's general elections. PFL candidate, José Reinaldo, was re-elected on October 6, 2002.

zh.s: 2002年10月6日，巴西马拉尼昂州举行州长选举，与巴西大选同时进行。自由阵线党候选人若泽·雷纳尔多于2002年10月6日再次当选。

en.t: 2004 President of the Hong Kong Legislative Council election
en.s: The election for the President of the Third Legislative Council took place on 6 October 2004 for members of the 3rd Legislative Council of Hong Kong to among themselves elect the President of the Legislative Council of Hong Kong for the duration of the council. Rita Fan from the pro-Beijing camp defeated Albert Ho, a democrat, and was re-elected as widely expected.

zh.s: 2004年10月6日，香港第三届立法会议员从议员中选举立法会主席，任期与该届立法会相同。亲北京阵营的范徐丽泰击败民主派候选人何俊仁，正如外界普遍预期，再次当选。

en.s: An indirect presidential election was held in Pakistan on 6 October 2007. This was before dissolution of parliament for the following general election to be held in 2008. The Pakistani legislature elected incumbent Pervez Musharraf by an overwhelming majority. The near-unanimous nature of Musharraf's victory was made possible by the absence of two key political opposition leaders, Nawaz Sharif and Benazir Bhutto. Nawaz Sharif had attempted to return to Pakistan before the election but was deported back into exile by the ruling government because of a gross violation of the agreement he had signed with the current regime to stay out of Pakistan and its politics for a period of ten years.

zh.s: 2007年10月6日，巴基斯坦举行间接总统选举，时间早于为2008年大选解散议会。巴基斯坦立法机构以压倒性多数选举现任总统佩尔韦兹·穆沙拉夫。由于两名重要反对派领袖纳瓦兹·谢里夫和贝娜齐尔·布托缺席，穆沙拉夫得以近乎一致的票数获胜。选举前，纳瓦兹·谢里夫曾试图返回巴基斯坦，但执政政府将他遣返回流亡地，理由是他严重违反了与现政权签署的协议，即10年内不得参与巴基斯坦政治并须留在境外。

en.s: Undeniable was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event promoted by Ring of Honor (ROH). It took place on October 6, 2007 from the Inman Sports Club in Edison, New Jersey and aired on PPV on January 18, 2008.

zh.s: 《不容置疑》是荣誉摔角（ROH）推广的职业摔角付费电视赛事，于2007年10月6日在新泽西州埃迪森的英曼体育俱乐部举行，并于2008年1月18日通过付费电视播出。

en.s: The Raleigh mayoral election of 2009 was held on 6 October 2009 to elect a Mayor of Raleigh, North Carolina. It was won by incumbent Charles Meeker, who defeated Larry D. Hudson, II in the first-round primary. Because Meeker won more than 50% in the first round, there was no need for a run-off. It was officially a non-partisan contest, but Meeker had won four previous elections as a Democrat.

zh.s: 2009年10月6日，北卡罗来纳州罗利举行市长选举。现任市长查尔斯·米克尔在首轮初选中击败拉里·D·哈德森二世。由于米克尔在首轮获得超过50%的选票，无需举行决选。选举正式上不设党派，但米克尔此前曾以民主党人身份赢得4次选举。

en.s: The 2009 Albuquerque mayoral election took place on October 6, 2009. Incumbent Mayor Martin Chávez ran for re-election to a third consecutive term, and fourth term overall. The city charter barred Chávez from seeking a third consecutive term, but he challenged the term limits, successfully arguing that the limit was unconstitutional under the state constitution.

zh.s: 2009年10月6日，阿尔伯克基举行市长选举。现任市长马丁·查韦斯竞选连任，寻求连续第三个任期、总计第四个任期。市章程禁止查韦斯连续竞选第三个任期，但他对任期限制提出挑战，并成功主张该限制违反州宪法。

en.s: General elections were held on October 6, 2011, to elect members of the 40th Legislative Assembly of Ontario. The Ontario Liberal Party was elected to a minority government, with the Progressive Conservative Party of Ontario (PC Party) serving as the Official Opposition and the Ontario New Democratic Party (NDP) serving as the third party. In the final result, Premier McGuinty's party fell one seat short of winning a majority government.

zh.s: 2011年10月6日，安大略省举行大选，选出第40届省立法议会成员。安大略自由党赢得少数派政府，进步保守党成为官方反对党，安大略新民主党成为第三党。最终结果中，省长麦坚迪领导的自由党比组建多数政府少1席。

en.s: The 2011 Memphis mayoral election took place on October 6, 2011. Incumbent Mayor A C Wharton, who was first elected in a 2009 special election, ran for re-election to a full term. He was challenged by a large field of candidates, the most well-known of whom were former City Councilmember Edmund Ford, Sr., and County Commissioner James Harvey.

zh.s: 2011年10月6日，孟菲斯举行市长选举。曾在2009年特别选举中当选的现任市长A·C·沃顿竞选完整任期。他面对多名候选人，其中最知名的是前市议员老埃德蒙·福特和县委员詹姆斯·哈维。

en.t: Results of the 2011 Ontario general election by riding
en.s: The 2011 Ontario general election took place on Thursday, October 6, 2011 to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of Ontario, Canada.

zh.t: 2011年安大略省大选各选区结果
zh.s: 2011年安大略省大选于2011年10月6日星期四举行，选出加拿大安大略省立法议会议员。

en.s: The Battle of Khirbet Al-Joz was fought between forces of the Syrian Army and the FSA for control of the town. On 6 October 2012, the FSA launched an attack on the government occupied village of Khirbet Al-Joz, near the Turkish border. The FSA took control of the village after a 12-hour-long battle with government forces.

zh.t: 希尔贝特阿尔乔兹战役
zh.s: 2012年10月6日，叙利亚自由军进攻靠近土耳其边境、由政府军占领的希尔贝特阿尔乔兹村。战斗持续12小时后，叙利亚自由军控制了该村。此前，叙利亚政府军与叙利亚自由军为争夺该镇控制权发生交战。

en.t: House of Hardcore holds its first wrestling event
en.s: On October 6, 2012, House of Hardcore held its first wrestling event at the Mid-Hudson Civic Center in Poughkeepsie, New York.

zh.t: House of Hardcore举办首场摔角赛事
zh.s: 2012年10月6日，House of Hardcore在美国纽约州波基普西的中哈德逊市民中心举办首场摔角赛事。

en.s: Battle of Domboa was fought between 7th Division of Nigerian military and Boko Haram insurgents in morning hours of 6 October 2013. Boko Haram entered the village at 4:30 AM, they forced priest of the local mosque to call for civilians to come to the mosque after which they opened fire on them, killing seven and injuring several.

zh.s: 2013年10月6日上午，尼日利亚军方第7师与博科圣地武装在丹博阿交战。凌晨4时30分，博科圣地进入村庄，迫使当地清真寺的伊玛目召集平民前往清真寺，随后向他们开枪，造成7人死亡、数人受伤。

en.s: The 2013 Battleground was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by WWE. It was the inaugural Battleground and took place on Sunday, October 6, 2013, at the First Niagara Center in Buffalo, New York. Battleground was originally announced to be the new annual October PPV for the promotion; however, it was moved up to July the following year.

zh.s: 2013年《战场》是WWE举办的首场同名职业摔角付费电视赛事，于2013年10月6日（星期日）在纽约州布法罗的第一尼亚加拉中心举行。WWE原计划将《战场》办成年度十月付费电视赛事，但次年将赛事提前至7月。

en.s: The 2013 East Asian Games (6–15 October 2013), officially known as the VI East Asian Games, was an international multi-sport event held in Tianjin, China. 2,422 Athletes from nine East Asian nations competed in 254 events in 24 sports. Tianjin 2013 is the last edition of East Asian Games before being replaced by East Asian Youth Games.

zh.s: 2013年10月6日至15日，天津举办2013年东亚运动会，正式名称为第六届东亚运动会。来自东亚9个国家和地区的2422名运动员参加24个大项的254场比赛。2013年天津东亚运动会是东亚运动会被东亚青年运动会取代前的最后一届。

en.s: The October Daraa offensive, code-named "wa al-Fajr wa Layali Asher" ("By the Dawn and ten nights"), was a military operation launched by Syrian rebels during the Syrian civil war in Daraa Governorate, in an attempt to take control of Al-Harra and Al-Sanamayn. This operation came after the successful rebel offensive in Quneitra province, which resulted in the rebels seizing the Syrian-controlled side of the Golan and the capture of a number of towns, villages and hills in Quneitra and Daraa provinces.

zh.s: 2014年10月达拉攻势的代号为“晨光与十夜”（wa al-Fajr wa Layali Asher），是叙利亚内战期间叙利亚反对派在达拉省发动的一次军事行动，试图夺取哈拉镇和萨纳迈因镇。攻势发生在反对派成功进攻库奈特拉省之后；此前，他们夺取了戈兰高地由叙利亚控制的一侧，以及库奈特拉省和达拉省的一些城镇、村庄和山丘。

en.s: The October 2015 Aden missile attack occurred on 6 October 2015, when a group of attackers targeted the Al-Qasr hotel which housed the Vice President and Prime Minister of Yemen; and served as a de facto military base for the Arab Coalition and the Yemen Army units loyal to President Abd Rabbuh Mansur Hadi. Although the Houthis were first suspected by Yemeni Transport Minister Badr Basalma of being behind the attack, the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant claimed responsibility for the attack.

zh.s: 2015年10月6日，袭击者将也门副总统兼总理居住的卡斯尔酒店作为目标。该酒店也被阿拉伯联军和忠于总统阿卜杜·拉布·曼苏尔·哈迪的也门军队用作事实上的军事基地。也门交通部长巴德尔·巴萨尔马最初怀疑胡塞武装发动袭击，之后伊拉克和黎凡特伊斯兰国宣称对此负责。

en.s: Cary, North Carolina, held an election for mayor on Tuesday, October 6, 2015. Harold Weinbrecht, the incumbent mayor, ran unopposed and won re-election to a third term. There was an option vote (commonly called "write-in").

zh.t: 2015年北卡罗来纳州凯瑞市市长选举
zh.s: 2015年10月6日（星期二），北卡罗来纳州凯瑞市举行市长选举。现任市长哈罗德·温布雷希特没有对手，成功连任第三个任期。选票上还设有“自填候选人”选项。

en.s: The biennial election for the Mayor of Raleigh, North Carolina was held on Tuesday, Oct. 6, 2015. The election was nonpartisan. Incumbent Mayor Nancy McFarlane won a third term in office.

zh.s: 2015年10月6日（星期二），北卡罗来纳州罗利举行市长选举，选举正式上不设党派。现任市长南希·麦克法兰成功连任第三个任期。

en.s: The Aden unrest was a conflict between Islamist factions, such as al-Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula, and Islamic State – Yemen Province, against the loyalists of president Abdrabbuh Mansour Hadi and later a conflict between UAE-backed and Saudi-backed factions within the coalition. In 2017, fighting also broke out between factions aligned with different members of the Saudi-led coalition namely Saudi Arabia-backed Hadi and Al-Islah and UAE-backed separatist Southern Transitional Council and Southern Movement.

zh.s: 亚丁动乱是也门境内伊斯兰主义派别之间的冲突，交战方包括阿拉伯半岛基地组织、伊斯兰国也门省，以及忠于总统阿卜杜拉布·曼苏尔·哈迪的武装。后来，冲突又扩展为联军内部由阿联酋支持和沙特阿拉伯支持的派别之间的战斗。2017年，沙特领导的联军成员所支持的派别也爆发冲突，包括沙特支持的哈迪及改革党一方，以及阿联酋支持的南方过渡委员会和南方运动分离主义者。

en.s: The 21st Busan International Film Festival was held from October 6 to October 15, 2016 at the Busan Cinema Center and was hosted by Sul Kyung-gu and Han Hyo-joo. A total of 301 films from 69 countries were screened at the festival, including 96 world premieres and 27 international premieres. A new Vision-Director Award was given to two promising directors of newly produced independent films in the Korean Cinema Today-Vision section, who have shown the most outstanding production skills.

zh.s: 第21届釜山国际电影节于2016年10月6日至15日在釜山电影中心举行，由薛景求和韩孝周主持。电影节共展映来自69个国家的301部影片，其中包括96部全球首映和27部国际首映。本届新增“Vision导演奖”，颁给韩国电影当代视觉单元中两名表现最出色的新锐独立电影导演。

en.s: The Plzeň municipal election in 2018 was held as part of 2018 Czech municipal elections on 5 and 6 October 2018. Plzeň was led by a coalition of the Civic Democratic Party, Czech Social Democratic Party, Christian and Democratic Union – Czechoslovak People's Party and Citizens Patriots. ANO 2011 was the strongest opposition party. ANO 2011 has won the popular vote but tied with the Civic Democratic Party by number of seats.

zh.s: 2018年10月5日至6日，比尔森举行市政选举，这是捷克全国市政选举的一部分。比尔森由公民民主党、捷克社会民主党、基督教民主联盟—捷克斯洛伐克人民党和公民爱国者联盟组成的联合政府执政。ANO 2011是最强的反对党。该党获得最多的普选票，但席位数与公民民主党持平。

en.s: The 2018 Super Show-Down was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by the American company WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw, SmackDown, and 205 Live. It was the inaugural Super Show-Down and took place on Saturday, October 6, 2018, at the Melbourne Cricket Ground in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia. The event aired live at 7:00 p.m.

zh.s: 2018年《超级对决》是美国WWE举办的职业摔角付费电视和线上直播赛事，参赛者来自Raw、SmackDown和205 Live三个主阵容品牌。这是首届《超级对决》赛事，于2018年10月6日（星期六）在澳大利亚维多利亚州墨尔本的墨尔本板球场举行。赛事于晚上7时直播。

en.s: The 2018 Prague municipal elections were held in Prague in on 5 and 6 October 2018 as part of nationwide municipal elections. All 65 seats of the Prague Assembly were up to elect. Full results were presented a day later, on 7 October 2018. The result was a narrow victory of the conservative Civic Democratic Party (ODS), which received 17.9 per cent of votes and 14 seats.

zh.s: 2018年10月5日至6日，布拉格举行市政选举，这是捷克全国市政选举的一部分。布拉格市议会的65个席位全部改选。完整结果于2018年10月7日公布。保守派公民民主党以微弱优势获胜，得票率为17.9%，赢得14席。

en.s: Senate elections were held in the Czech Republic on 5 and 6 October 2018 alongside municipal elections, with a second round held on 12 and 13 October 2018. The Conservative Civic Democratic Party (ODS) won the election with 10 seats. Governing parties ANO 2011 and the Czech Social Democratic Party were heavily defeated, winning only 1 seat each.

zh.s: 2018年10月5日至6日，捷克共和国举行参议院选举，并同时举行市政选举；第二轮于10月12日至13日举行。保守派公民民主党获胜，赢得10席。执政党ANO 2011和捷克社会民主党遭到重挫，各仅赢得1席。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in the Czech Republic on 5 and 6 October 2018, alongside elections for the Senate.

zh.s: 2018年10月5日至6日，捷克共和国举行市政选举，并同时举行参议院选举。

en.s: UFC 229: Khabib vs. McGregor was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) that was held on October 6, 2018. The fight took place between Khabib Nurmagomedov and Conor McGregor at the T-Mobile Arena in Paradise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Area, United States. This event was the most-bought UFC (and MMA) pay-per-view of all time with a buyrate of 2.4 million.

zh.s: UFC 229（哈比卜对阵麦格雷戈）是终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）举办的一场综合格斗付费电视赛事，于2018年10月6日在美国内华达州天堂市的T-Mobile竞技场举行，该市属于拉斯维加斯都会区。按购买率计算，这是有史以来最受欢迎的UFC及综合格斗付费电视赛事，购买量为240万次。

en.s: Brno municipal election in 2018 was held as part of 2018 Czech municipal elections. ANO 2011 led by incumbent Mayor Petr Vokřál received highest number of votes being followed by Civic Democratic Party (ODS). ODS formed coalition with KDU-ČSL, ČSSD and Pirates after the election. Markéta Vaňková of ODS became the new Mayor.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2018年布尔诺市政选举是捷克2018年市政选举的一部分。由现任市长彼得·沃克拉尔领导的ANO 2011获得最多选票，其次是公民民主党（ODS）。选举后，公民民主党与基督教民主联盟—捷克斯洛伐克人民党、捷克社会民主党和海盗党组成联合政府。公民民主党的马克塔·万科娃出任新市长。

en.s: The 2019 LTP Charleston Pro Tennis II was a professional tennis tournament played on outdoor clay courts. It was the fifth edition of the tournament which was part of the 2019 ITF Women's World Tennis Tour. It took place in Charleston, South Carolina, United States between 30 September and 6 October 2019.

zh.t: 2019年LTP查尔斯顿职业网球赛二站
zh.s: 2019年LTP查尔斯顿职业网球赛二站是一项在室外红土球场举行的职业网球赛事，也是2019年ITF女子世界网球巡回赛的一站。这是该赛事第5届，于2019年9月30日至10月6日在美国南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿举行。

en.s: Parliamentary elections took place in Tunisia on 6 October 2019.

zh.s: 2019年10月6日，突尼斯举行议会选举。

en.s: The 2019 Portuguese legislative election was held on 6 October 2019. All 230 seats to the Assembly of the Republic were contested. The Socialist Party (PS) won the elections with 36 percent of the votes and 108 seats, a gain of 22 compared with 2015. The PS won the big districts of Porto and Lisbon, although Porto was closer than expected, and was able to gain districts from the PSD, like Aveiro and Viana do Castelo, by razor thin margins.

zh.s: 2019年10月6日，葡萄牙举行议会选举，改选共和国议会全部230个席位。社会党（PS）赢得36%的选票和108席，比2015年增加22席。社会党赢得波尔图和里斯本等大选区，但波尔图的结果比预期更接近。该党还以极小差距从社会民主党手中夺得阿威罗和维亚纳堡等选区。

en.s: UFC 243: Whittaker vs. Adesanya was a mixed martial arts pay-per-view event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on October 6, 2019, at Marvel Stadium in Melbourne, Australia.

zh.s: UFC 243（惠特克对阵阿德萨尼亚）是终极格斗冠军赛举办的一场综合格斗付费电视赛事，于2019年10月6日在澳大利亚墨尔本的漫威体育场举行。

en.s: The 2019 Hell in a Cell was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held for wrestlers the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was the 11th annual Hell in a Cell event and took place on October 6, 2019, at the Golden 1 Center in Sacramento, California.

zh.s: 2019年《地狱牢笼》是WWE举办的职业摔角付费电视和线上直播赛事，参赛者来自Raw和SmackDown两个主阵容品牌。这是第11届年度《地狱牢笼》赛事，于2019年10月6日在加利福尼亚州萨克拉门托的黄金一号中心举行。

en.s: The 26th Busan International Film Festival opened on October 6, 2021 at the Busan Cinema Center in Busan, South Korea with the South Korean film Heaven: To the Land of Happiness by Im Sang-soo. Park So-dam and Song Joong-ki hosted the opening of the festival, which was streamed live on YouTube. In the 26th edition, 223 films from 70 countries were officially invited to the festival. 63 community service screenings were also part of the festival.

zh.s: 第26届釜山国际电影节于2021年10月6日在韩国釜山电影中心开幕，开幕影片是林常树执导的韩国电影《天福地》。朴素丹和宋仲基主持了开幕式，典礼通过YouTube直播。本届电影节共邀请来自70个国家的223部影片参展，另有63场社区服务放映活动。

en.s: On October 6, 2021, al-Qaeda-allied jihadists from Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin (JNIM) ambushed a Malian convoy in Mopti Region, killing scores of Malian soldiers. The ensuing firefight left dozens of jihadists dead.

zh.s: 2021年10月6日，基地组织盟友、伊斯兰与穆斯林支持组织（JNIM）的圣战分子在马里莫普提区伏击一支马里车队，造成数十名马里士兵死亡。随后交火又造成数十名圣战分子死亡。

en.t: 2021 New South Wales National Party leadership election
en.s: The 2021 leadership election for the National Party of Australia – NSW was held on 6 October 2021 to elect a new leader of the New South Wales Division of the National Party of Australia and subsequently the Deputy Premier of New South Wales, following the resignation of John Barilaro. The election was conducted among the National Party members of the Parliament of New South Wales and contested between Melinda Pavey and Paul Toole.

zh.t: 2021年新南威尔士州国家党党魁选举
zh.s: 2021年10月6日，澳大利亚国家党新南威尔士州分部举行党魁选举，选出新任党魁，并由其接任新南威尔士州副州长。此前，约翰·巴里拉罗辞职。选举由新南威尔士州议会中的国家党议员投票，候选人为梅琳达·佩维和保罗·图尔。

en.s: The 2022 United Conservative Party leadership election was held on October 6 in Alberta to select a new leader of the United Conservative Party and Premier of Alberta. The leadership election was triggered following the May 18 leadership review in which the United Conservative Party membership voted 51.4 per cent in support of incumbent Premier Jason Kenney's leadership.

zh.s: 2022年10月6日，艾伯塔省举行联合保守党党魁选举，选出新任党魁和省长。选举由5月18日举行的党魁信任投票触发；当时，只有51.4%的党员支持现任省长杰森·肯尼继续担任党魁。

en.s: The 2024 Rio Branco municipal election took place in the city of Rio Branco, Brazil on 6 October 2024. Voters elected a mayor, vice mayor, and 21 councillors. The incumbent mayor is Tião Bocalom of the PL. Bocalom was formerly elected mayor in 2020 as a member of the PP. Bocalom defeated the former mayor of the city, Marcus Alexandre in the first round.

zh.s: 2024年10月6日，巴西里奥布朗库举行市政选举，选出市长、副市长和21名市议员。现任市长蒂昂·博卡洛姆属于自由党（PL），他曾于2020年代表进步党（PP）当选市长。本次他在首轮投票中击败前市长马库斯·亚历山大。

en.s: The 2024 Fortaleza mayoral election took place on 6 October 2024. Voters elected a mayor, a vice mayor, and 43 councillors. The incumbent mayor, José Sarto, a member of the Democratic Labour Party (PDT), was elected in 2020 for his first term and intends to run for reelection. Candidates André Fernandes (PL) and Evandro Leitão (PT) were the most voted and advanced for a runoff, held on 27 October 2024.

zh.s: 2024年10月6日，福塔莱萨举行市政选举，选出市长、副市长和43名市议员。现任市长若泽·萨尔托属于民主工党（PDT），于2020年首次当选，计划竞选连任。安德烈·费尔南德斯和埃万德罗·莱唐得票最多，进入10月27日举行的决选。两人分别来自自由党（PL）和劳工党（PT）。

en.s: The 2024 Rio de Janeiro municipal election took place on 6 October 2024. Voters elected a mayor, vice mayor, and 51 city council members. The incumbent mayor, Eduardo Paes of the Social Democratic Party (PSD), was reelected with his second term to begin on 1 January 2025 and end on 31 December 2028.

zh.s: 2024年10月6日，里约热内卢举行市政选举，选出市长、副市长和51名市议员。社会民主党（PSD）籍现任市长爱德华多·帕埃斯成功连任，第二个任期于2025年1月1日开始，至2028年12月31日结束。

en.s: The 2024 Curitiba mayoral election was held in Curitiba on 6 October 2024 to elect the mayor, vice mayor, and 38 councillors of the Municipal Chamber of Curitiba. Incumbent mayor Rafael Greca (PSD) was not eligible to run for a third consecutive term, having been elected in 2016 and re-elected in 2020. As no mayoral candidate received more than half of the valid votes in the first round, a runoff election was held on 27 October 2024.

zh.s: 2024年10月6日，库里蒂巴举行市政选举，选出市长、副市长和38名市议员。现任市长拉斐尔·格雷卡（PSD）于2016年当选、2020年连任，因此不得连续第三次竞选。首轮投票中没有市长候选人获得过半数有效选票，10月27日举行决选。

en.s: Héroes Inmortales XVI (Spanish for "Immortal Heroes Sixteen) was a professional wrestling event produced and scripted by the Mexican professional wrestling promotion Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA). The event took place on October 6, 2024, at Auditorio Benito Juárez in Zapopan, Jalisco, Mexico. It was the sixteenth Héroes Inmortales show, held annually in honor of the promotion's deceased founder Antonio Peña and it featured the Copa Antonio Peña tournament named in his honor.

zh.s: “不朽英雄十六”（西班牙语：Héroes Inmortales XVI）是墨西哥职业摔角推广组织AAA举办并编排的赛事，于2024年10月6日在哈利斯科州萨波潘的贝尼托·华雷斯礼堂举行。这是第16届“不朽英雄”赛事，每年举办一次，纪念该推广组织已故创办人安东尼奥·佩尼亚。赛事包括以他命名的安东尼奥·佩尼亚杯锦标赛。

en.s: The 2024 Porto Alegre mayoral election took place on 6 October 2024. Voters elected a mayor, a vice mayor, and 36 councillors. The incumbent mayor, Sebastião Melo, a member of the Brazilian Democratic Movement (MDB), was elected in 2020 for his first term and ran for reelection. The mayor's term will begin on 1 January 2025 and end on 31 December 2028.

zh.s: 2024年10月6日，阿雷格里港举行市政选举，选出市长、副市长和36名市议员。巴西民主运动党（MDB）籍现任市长塞巴斯蒂昂·梅洛竞选连任。市长新任期将于2025年1月1日开始，至2028年12月31日结束。

en.t: Cuiabá holds the first round of its municipal election
en.s: On October 6, 2024, voters in Cuiabá, Brazil, took part in the first round of the municipal election. The mayoral contest went to a runoff on October 27.
en.n: October 6 was the first round, rather than the final mayoral result.

zh.t: 库亚巴举行市政选举首轮投票
zh.s: 2024年10月6日，巴西库亚巴举行市政选举首轮投票。市长选举未在首轮决出胜负，于10月27日进行第二轮投票。
zh.n: 10月6日是首轮投票日期，并非市长选举最终结果产生的日期。

en.s: The 2024 Salvador municipal election took place in the city of Salvador, Brazil on 6 October 2024. Voters will elect a mayor, vice mayor, and 43 councillors. The incumbent mayor, Bruno Reis, of the Brazil Union (UNIÃO), is able to run for a second term. If the most voted candidate on the first round doesn't achieve more than 50% of the votes, a second round will happen on 27 October 2024.

zh.s: 2024年10月6日，巴西萨尔瓦多举行市政选举，选出市长、副市长和43名市议员。巴西联盟党（UNIÃO）籍现任市长布鲁诺·雷斯可以竞选第二个任期。如果首轮得票最多的候选人没有获得超过50%的选票，10月27日将举行决选。

loc: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Bosnia and Herzegovina on 6 October 2024 to elect mayors and assemblies in 140 municipalities. Due to sustaining major damage and suffering casualties following heavy floods two days prior, elections were postponed and held on 20 October in the municipalities of, Kiseljak, Kreševo, Konjic and Fojnica. Elections in the town of Jablanica, which suffered most of the flood damage, were held on 3 November 2024.

zh.s: 2024年10月6日，波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那举行市政选举，选出140个市镇的市长和议会成员。此前两天，当地遭遇严重洪灾并有人伤亡，因此基塞利亚克、克雷舍沃、科尼茨和福伊尼察市镇的选举推迟至10月20日举行。洪灾破坏最严重的亚布兰尼察镇于2024年11月3日举行选举。

en.s: The 2024 Goiânia municipal election took place in the city of Goiânia, Brazil on 6 October 2024. Voters elected 41 councillors. A second round was held on October 27 as no candidate achieved 50% in the first round for mayor. The incumbent mayor is Rogério Cruz of Solidarity. Cruz became mayor after the death of Maguito Vilela due to COVID-19. Cruz was elected as a member of the Republicanos.

zh.s: 2024年10月6日，巴西戈伊亚尼亚举行市政选举，选出41名市议员。由于首轮投票中没有市长候选人获得50%选票，10月27日举行决选。现任市长罗杰里奥·克鲁兹属于团结党。他在马吉托·维莱拉因新冠去世后接任市长，并以共和党人身份当选。

en.s: The 2024 Belo Horizonte municipal election took place in the city of Belo Horizonte, Brazil on 6 October 2024. Voters elected 41 councillors. A second round was held on October 27 as no candidate achieved 50% in the first round for mayor. The incumbent mayor is Fuad Noman of the Social Democratic Party.

zh.s: 2024年10月6日，巴西贝洛奥里藏特举行市政选举，选出41名市议员。由于首轮投票中没有市长候选人获得50%选票，10月27日举行决选。现任市长富阿德·诺曼属于社会民主党。

en.s: The 2024 Vitória municipal election took place in the city of Vitória, Brazil on 6 October 2024. Voters elected a mayor, vice mayor, and 21 councillors. The incumbent mayor, Lorenzo Pazolini of the Republicanos was elected first in 2020. Pazolini was reelected in the first round.

zh.s: 2024年10月6日，巴西维多利亚举行市政选举，选出市长、副市长和21名市议员。共和党籍现任市长洛伦佐·帕佐利尼于2020年首次当选，并在首轮投票中成功连任。

en.s: The 2024 Teresina municipal election took place in the city of Teresina, Brazil on 6 October 2024. Voters elected a mayor, vice mayor, and 31 councillors. The incumbent mayor is José Pessoa Leal or Dr. Pessoa of the Democratic Renewal Party. Dr. Pessoa was formerly elected mayor in 2020 as a member of the MDB.

zh.s: 2024年10月6日，巴西特雷西纳举行市政选举，选出市长、副市长和31名市议员。现任市长若泽·佩索阿·莱亚尔又称“佩索阿医生”，属于民主革新党。他曾在2020年代表巴西民主运动党当选市长。

en.s: The 2024 Macapá municipal election took place in the city of Macapá, Brazil on 6 October 2024. Voters elected a mayor, vice mayor, and 23 councillors. The incumbent mayor is Antônio Furlan, otherwise known as Dr. Furlan, of the Brazilian Democratic Movement. He was elected mayor in 2020 as a member of Cidadania in the second round against Josiel Alcolumbre, the brother of the former president of the Federal Senate Davi Alcolumbre.

zh.s: 2024年10月6日，巴西马卡帕举行市政选举，选出市长、副市长和23名市议员。现任市长安东尼奥·富兰又称“富兰医生”，属于巴西民主运动党。他于2020年代表公民党在决选中当选，击败若西埃尔·阿尔科伦布雷。若西埃尔是前联邦参议院议长达维·阿尔科伦布雷的兄弟。

en.s: The 2024 São Paulo municipal election took place on 6 October 2024, with a runoff held on 27 October. Voters elected a mayor, vice mayor, and 55 city council members. The incumbent mayor, Ricardo Nunes of the Brazilian Democratic Movement (MDB), ran for reelection.

zh.s: 2024年10月6日，圣保罗举行市政选举，并于10月27日举行决选。选民选出市长、副市长和55名市议员。巴西民主运动党（MDB）籍现任市长里卡多·努内斯竞选连任。

en.s: Municipal elections took place in Brazil on 6 October 2024, with any runoffs scheduled for 27 October.

zh.s: 2024年10月6日，巴西举行市政选举，任何需要举行的决选都安排在10月27日。

en.s: The 2024 Recife municipal election took place in the city of Recife, Brazil on 6 October 2024. Voters elected a mayor, vice mayor, and 39 councillors. The incumbent mayor is João Campos of the PSB. Campos is the son of the former governor of Pernambuco Eduardo Campos, who died in a plane crash while running in the 2014 presidential election.

zh.s: 2024年10月6日，巴西累西腓举行市政选举，选出市长、副市长和39名市议员。社会党（PSB）籍现任市长若昂·坎波斯是前伯南布哥州州长爱德华多·坎波斯之子。爱德华多在2014年竞选总统期间死于空难。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Tunisia on 6 October 2024. They were the first presidential elections since the promulgation of the 2022 constitution and were boycotted by most parties. After rejecting several candidacies, including those of the main opponents of incumbent president Kais Saied, the Independent High Authority for Elections (ISIE) confirmed the candidacies of only three candidates; Saied and former deputies Zouhair Maghzaoui and Ayachi Zammel, rejecting those of Mondher Zenaidi, Abdellatif Mekki and Imed Daïmi, who had been reinstated by the Administrative Court.

zh.s: 2024年10月6日，突尼斯举行总统选举。这是2022年宪法颁布后的首次总统选举，多数政党抵制了选举。独立选举高级委员会（ISIE）驳回了多名候选人的申请，包括现任总统凯斯·赛义德的主要对手，最终只确认3人参选：赛义德，以及前议员祖海尔·马格扎维和阿亚希·扎梅尔。委员会还驳回了蒙泽尔·泽奈迪、阿卜杜拉提夫·迈基和伊马德·达伊米的申请；行政法院此前已恢复这三人的参选资格。

en.s: The 2024 Maceió municipal election took place in the city of Maceió, Brazil on 6 October 2024. Voters elected a mayor, vice mayor, and 21 councillors. The incumbent mayor is João Henrique Caldas or JHC of the PL. JHC was formerly elected mayor in 2020 as a member of the PSB. JHC was previously a Federal Deputy and a State Deputy.

zh.s: 2024年10月6日，巴西马塞约举行市政选举，选出市长、副市长和21名市议员。自由党（PL）籍现任市长若昂·恩里克·卡尔达斯（JHC）曾于2020年代表社会党（PSB）当选市长。此前，他还曾担任联邦众议员和州议员。

en.s: The 2024 Florianópolis municipal election took place in the city of Florianópolis, Brazil on 6 October 2024. Voters elected a mayor, vice mayor, and 43 councillors. The incumbent mayor, Topázio Neto, of the PSD, the vice mayor elected in 2020 as a member of the Republicanos, took office on March 31, 2022, with the resignation of the incumbent, Gean Loureiro (UNIÃO).

zh.t: 2024年弗洛里亚诺波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 2024年10月6日，巴西弗洛里亚诺波利斯举行市政选举，选出市长、副市长和43名市议员。现任市长托帕齐奥·内托属于社会民主党（PSD）；他在2020年当选副市长，时属共和党。2022年3月31日，时任市长吉安·洛雷罗（UNIÃO）辞职后，内托接任市长。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Mostar on 6 October 2024 to elect members of the City Council and the mayor of Mostar. The elections were part of the Bosnian municipal elections. It was the first elections after 2008 to be held during the same time as the rest of the country, since the previous ones were held on 20 December 2020, 35 days apart.

en.s: The 2024 São Paulo Torneio Internacional de Tênis Feminino was a professional tennis tournament played on outdoor clay courts. en.s: A by-election was held on October 6, 2025, in the provincial riding of Miramichi West in New Brunswick, Canada. The by-election is to fill the vacant seat left by the resignation of PC MLA Michael Dawson who successfully ran in Miramichi—Grand Lake to represent the region federally during the 2025 federal election. It is the first time the Libertarian Party of New Brunswick has run in Miramichi.

zh.t: 2025年米拉米奇西选区省议会补选
zh.s: 2025年10月6日，加拿大新不伦瑞克省米拉米奇西选区举行补选，以填补空缺的省议会席位。进步保守党议员迈克尔·道森辞职，此前他在2025年联邦大选中成功当选米拉米奇—大湖区联邦议员。新不伦瑞克自由党首次在米拉米奇参选。

en.s: The 2025 Alberta teachers' strike was a public education teachers' strike and labour dispute that took place across Alberta, Canada, and affected the province's education system, resulting in a suspension of classes from October 6, 2025, to October 29, 2025. It was ended after the Notwithstanding Clause was invoked. The strike, organized by the Alberta Teachers' Association (ATA), was the result of multiple disagreements with the Government of Alberta over the terms of a new labour contract.

zh.s: 2025年阿尔伯塔省教师罢工是加拿大阿尔伯塔省公共教育系统教师发起的一次罢工和劳资争议，导致全省学校从2025年10月6日至10月29日停课。政府援引《不容克减条款》后，罢工结束。罢工由阿尔伯塔教师协会组织，起因是该协会与阿尔伯塔省政府对新劳资合同存在多项分歧。
